kids.name: source

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Frame, past 600 ms: [FP] or F (§4.9 L377; §8.1 L738) starts the /market/footprint load; candles and zoom stay, [FP] pending, the strip line; cells then paint in one frame (§5 L397; D17 L167). Before 600 ms: the mark alone (E12-D02 D-5).

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Zoomed out: at a candle zoom the first frame is L2 or L3 with the badge (L397, L378); 100 rows of 7.0 px: L2 (§3 L197-198), no text or outline, marks kept, AC 2's badge (L422).

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Bootstrap: E11-D02's skeleton, no cells (L397; E11-D02 L407). Failure: candles only, the notice with Retry, Dismiss and the code under Details (L397, PROPOSED; `11` global AC 5).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Every session: market data, identical in demo and live (§5 L408). No role- or state-gated footprint control: no T2 (§6.5 L606-617; G-T2 checked); [Draw] and the rail are E14's. [FP] loading is busy, not T2 (standing ruling): pressed, focusable, operable, no lock; aria-busy on the chart region (`14` L697), not on [FP].

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Tab: toolbar ([FP] and Chart | Table, one roving stop) → the strip's actions (failure: Retry, Dismiss, then Details, the drawn order) → legend → plot (one roving stop, the data cursor) → right gutter → time axis → cluster (§8.1 L721-724); no status chip or left gutter here. F toggles (L738).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Never moved by a system event (E12-D02 D-11): the line, the paint, the badge and the notice take none; the badge is no Tab stop (§5.1 L434); Esc never dismisses the notice (D-7). Retry or Dismiss removes the notice and its focused button: focus to the plot cursor (E12-D02 L35).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Press: the toggle's state (§8.1 L738). Past 600 ms: once, polite, the panel's live region (E12-D02 L283), words not written (gap); chart region aria-busy (`14` L697).

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Zoomed out: the badge sentence, polite, once per tier change; it joins the chart's description, the cursor adds "footprint at low detail" (§5.1 L422, L434-436).
